description:
Outcome: Prototype phone journeys; source: brief.md First version 1-4 and Constraints; conversation map deferral.
Scope: Gardener sign-in/application/allocation/report screens and coordinator application/allocation list/problem inbox; synthetic data only.
Excludes: online payments and tool lending; plot map excluded from first version and retained only in L4.
Acceptance: Large text, plain language, labelled controls, visible focus, keyboard access and usable phone layouts.
Behaviour: Prototype loading, empty, error and retry states; preserve form values.
Verification: Owner phone and keyboard walkthrough.
Prerequisites: none (proposal references; wired to actual IDs after creation).
Assumptions: Approved setup assumptions: one household account; coordinator chooses local timezone/application window; default occupancy March 1-October 31; returning means immediately prior season; initial final allocation after February 1 cutoff, preferences advisory and application order within groups; FIFO after initial allocation; no same-season reapplication after withdrawal/release; active holdings unique with history preserved; reports own active plot only and coordinator-readable; daily digest defaults to 08:00 local, skips empty days. No existing implementation. C1 reviews provisional domain rules.
title: Prototype phone journeys
